coordinateConvention: Three.js Y-up; world scene unit=40 m; partner local scene unit=100 m
limits: No GPU rendering, browser controls or physical phone performance acceptance.
Roof-wall joins and other intended internal decorative mesh intersections are not treated as navigation failures.
Landmark AABB overlaps are broad-phase candidates, not proof of triangle interpenetration.
